name: gw-certify
description: GW Certify certification-style MCQ testing platform.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,blue "npm run dev --workspace @gw-certify/web" "npm run dev --workspace @gw-certify/api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @gw-certify/web && npm run build --workspace @gw-certify/api
scripts.start: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,blue "npm run start --workspace @gw-certify/web" "npm run start --workspace @gw-certify/api"
